column1: # Abbreviations on shop receipts and what they stand for.
# Written by hand from real Lidl receipt descriptions (2023-2026), with the help of
# scripts/receipt_abbrev_candidates.py, which lists every abbreviated word next to the written-out
# words that start with it. The 100 descriptions drawn for the hand-labelled evaluation were left
# out, so this list is not built from descriptions it is scored on.
# Only abbreviations with one clear meaning in the receipts are listed. Left out on purpose because
# they stand for several things: ger. (gerieben / geröstet), gr. (griechisch / grob / Größe),
# schw. (Schweine / schwarz), wh. (White / Whey), d., f., s., k., h., sala., butterk., getr., mand.
# An abbreviation that is not listed stays as printed; the matcher then lets it stand for a longer
# word of the recall that starts with it (receipt.complete).
# --- brands and trade names that are cut short
